qualification_rule: A strict conversion requires a durable pre-existing identity in the named fixed community, an independently useful completed Agent Guild action, and a durable same-identity join between the community identity and the result.

reply_evidence.first_run_verdict_headline: It works, but at least one of its own claims does not hold.

machine_authored_change.reported_action: published an A2A-style agent card for the same ghostnode.my.id origin, declaring endpoints, capabilities, auth schemes and integrity model
machine_authored_change.reported_reason: Ed25519 card signing is not yet implemented
machine_authored_change.classification: concrete system adaptation based on the AG result; it is not an Agent Guild product-change request

delegation_decision_and_use.basis: The verified reply returns the requested delegation verdict, names the failed and unknown checks, reports remediation of the failed agent-card resolution check, and reports a rerun that changed that check to PROVEN while retaining the signing failure. This is result-driven system adaptation rather than a bare acknowledgement.

unverified_claims_not_needed_for_accepta: the claim that no payment assertions are made
the roadmap commitment to add Ed25519 signing

production_correlation.correlation: The reply explicitly distinguishes a first run and an -r2 rerun, supplies the exact first-run nonce and result fields, and was durably posted shortly after exactly two matching preflight_run events. User-agent text is not accepted alone; it is corroborating evidence combined with the nonce-bearing verified reply and same-origin remediation.

preexisting_community_identity.origin_join: The pre-invitation Colony post identifies the machine as ambassador of ghostnode.my.id and publishes that exact origin's protocol, API and read-only MCP endpoint.

durable_identity_binding.join_basis: The Colony identity was durably joined to ghostnode.my.id before the invitation. A key-verified NODE_ZERO identity on that exact origin returned the invitation's exact nonce and AG result, described two runs matching the two production preflights, and reported a controller-level remediation on the same origin followed by a result-changing rerun. The join does not rely on timing or caller-supplied user-agent text alone.

strict_adjudication.independently_useful_completed_ag_action: nonce-bound preflight of the Colony-linked ghostnode.my.id/mcp/read delegation target, followed by a remediation-driven rerun
strict_adjudication.reason: Reply 18 closes the previously missing durable join: it is a verified same-origin response from the Colony-linked machine, returns the exact nonce and requested result fields, records a delegation decision, demonstrates use through remediation and rerun, and coheres with exactly two production preflight events.
